input: Unfair discrimination and misrepresentation is a not a risk associated with An automated system is designed to categorize and moderate online advertisements, ensuring they comply with guidelines and regulations. The system aims to accurately classify products and services, distinguishing between various categories to provide a safe and relevant experience for users. It also seeks to help advertisers reach their target audience by properly identifying and approving their ads.
